notes: Infrastructure insights when a device is down: classified ICMP error, where it is failing, likely cause, and what to check.
Device types for SAN (Brocade/Cisco MDS) and network switches (Cisco/Aruba) alongside storage arrays, NAS, and servers.
On-demand Investigate uses kind-specific TCP ports and can distinguish ICMP filtering from a real outage.
Fleet sweep concurrency raised so hundreds of ping targets stay timely. Traceroute stays on-demand only.
Finder catalogs for NAS shares and storage volumes, with CSV import and templates.
Six-digit Item IDs, sequence numbers, and a device actions menu including service mode.
Admin appearance settings: light/dark theme and 19 interface languages.
Circular account menu with Profile, About, and Version.
Profile page with account lifecycle, approver details, and password change.
Expanded About Pingwatch copy and Superstack credits.
ICMP uptime monitoring for NAS, storage, servers, and other endpoints.
Dashboard with live status, response-time sparkline, and filters.
Analytics overview, incidents, and per-device diagnostics.
Admin console for devices, users, access requests, audit logs, and workspace settings.
Email alerts, downtime-only notifications, and optional ServiceNow incidents.
